headline: TEN-DEEP: the ten-floor dungeon is live
lede: Session 32 replaced the trademarked dungeon crawler with our own world — TEN DEEPS below a fallen keep, ten proven mazes, a new bestiary and a crowned boss — rules untouched, every floor audited.

notes.text: TEN-DEEP stage 1 merged: ten seeded floors, new monsters (Grave Ghoul, Bog Troll, Minotauros, Deep Wyrm) and THE HOLLOW KING, proven winnable by the shipping autopilot and re-proven with one fewer of every supply it consumed.
The ten-floor proof caught a solver deadlock the three-floor game never hit: the autopilot stood on a full MP spring re-issuing USE forever. It now drinks only when dry.

WIZARDRY is retired: directory, route, harness keys and CI gates all renamed (tendeepcheck 676/676, tendeepplay 25/25 with zero page errors); a polish pass for stone texture, motion and spell VFX is filed as #1138.

look.text: Crawl the ten deeps — tap to start, stairs to DEEP 10
